lines.zh: 雪地被我一脚踩实
lines.en: The snow packs solid under my foot

lines.zh: 我走在雪原上，一步一个深坑
lines.en: I cross the snowfield leaving deep prints

lines.zh: 身上带着人造的味儿
lines.en: I carry the smell of something made

lines.zh: 背后那串脚印，只有我一个人
lines.en: The trail behind me belongs to only one

lines.zh: 风卷雪打过来，我不躲
lines.en: Wind drives snow at me and I do not flinch

lines.zh: 我低头走，眼睛却朝前
lines.en: I walk with my head down, eyes straight ahead

lines.zh: 雪原太空，脚步声传得远
lines.en: The snowfield is empty and my steps carry

lines.zh: 我甩了甩胳膊，雪落下来
lines.en: I shake my arms and snow falls off

lines.zh: 走到哪儿，那儿的雪就脏了
lines.en: Wherever I walk, the snow turns dirty

lines.zh: 我借着坡势往下滑了一截
lines.en: I let the slope carry me down a stretch

lines.zh: 就这么走着，不喘不喊
lines.en: I just walk, without panting or calling out

lines.zh: 寒冷对我没什么用
lines.en: The cold does very little to me

lines.zh: 我站着，雪落在肩上不化
lines.en: I stand and the snow on my shoulders does not melt

lines.zh: 眼睛不眨，雪原也不动
lines.en: My eyes do not blink, and the snowfield does not move

lines.zh: 这具身子是造出来的
lines.en: This body was built

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看自己的手背
lines.en: I lift a hand and study its back

lines.zh: 雪原上没什么可看的
lines.en: There is little worth seeing on a snowfield

lines.zh: 我等得起，我不用吃
lines.en: I can wait, I do not need to eat

lines.zh: 冷风吹过，我一动不动
lines.en: Cold wind passes, and I do not stir

lines.zh: 身上没有体温，雪不化
lines.en: No body heat in me, so the snow stays

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪上很清楚
lines.en: My shadow shows clearly on the snow

lines.zh: 脑子里只有一个念头，找到人
lines.en: One thought sits in my head, find people

lines.zh: 雪压弯了松枝，我看了一眼
lines.en: A pine bough bends under snow, I glance at it

lines.zh: 我动了动手指，关节不发响
lines.en: I flex my fingers, they do not creak

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我看见了
lines.en: I see the white breath you exhale

lines.zh: 雪原上就你一个活物
lines.en: You are the only living thing on this snowfield

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不带什么情绪
lines.en: I stare at you with no particular feeling

lines.zh: 你的心跳，比雪声响
lines.en: Your heartbeat is louder than the snow

lines.zh: 我往前半步，雪陷下去
lines.en: I take half a step, the snow sinks

lines.zh: 这么冷的天，你跑不远的
lines.en: On a day this cold, you will not run far

lines.zh: 我不开口，开口也无话
lines.en: I do not speak, and I have nothing to say if I did

lines.zh: 你身上的气，比看上去多
lines.en: Your ki is more than you look

lines.zh: 我在看你的关节怎么弯
lines.en: I am watching how your joints bend

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神，我又不恨你
lines.en: Do not look at me like that, I do not hate you

lines.zh: 我的脸没有表情，这是设计
lines.en: My face shows nothing, that is by design

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我记住了
lines.en: You took one step back, I noted it

lines.zh: 身上落着雪，我照样看着你
lines.en: Snow settles on me and I keep watching

lines.zh: 你的气味在冷空气里很清楚
lines.en: Your scent is very clear in the cold air

lines.zh: 我眨了一下眼，就一下
lines.en: I blink once, only once

lines.zh: 你打算站着不动多久
lines.en: How long do you plan to stand still

lines.zh: 我不需要理由就会动手
lines.en: I do not need a reason to move

lines.zh: 看你的时候，我在算距离
lines.en: Watching you, I am measuring distance

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，没什么反应
lines.en: I took a hit and showed no reaction

lines.zh: 伤口很快就收口了
lines.en: The wound closes quickly

lines.zh: 你打得比看上去准
lines.en: You hit more precisely than you look

lines.zh: 我没有喊，喊也没用
lines.en: I do not cry out, it would do no good

lines.zh: 身上多了道痕，就留着
lines.en: A new mark on me, I will keep it

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，又抬头
lines.en: I glance down, then lift my head again

lines.zh: 这具身子能修
lines.en: This body can be repaired

lines.zh: 你这一下有点分量
lines.en: That blow had some weight

lines.zh: 我退了一步，马上又站回去
lines.en: I take a step back and immediately retake it

lines.zh: 疼是疼，不影响
lines.en: It hurts, but it does not hinder

lines.zh: 你那些东西，我不用
lines.en: Those things of yours, I have no use for

lines.zh: 我闻了一下，没什么反应
lines.en: I sniff once and have no reaction

lines.zh: 我不靠吃活着
lines.en: I do not live by eating

lines.zh: 你举着手，举得有些累了
lines.en: Your arm is held up and getting tired

lines.zh: 省下吧，留着给自己
lines.en: Save it, keep it for yourself

lines.zh: 雪落在那东西上，很快白了
lines.en: Snow falls on it and turns it white

lines.zh: 这东西对我是废料
lines.en: This is scrap to me

lines.zh: 你把食物递给人造的东西
lines.en: You are offering food to something built

lines.zh: 我看了两眼，转开头
lines.en: I look twice and turn away

lines.zh: 收起来，别挡道
lines.en: Put it away and get out of the way

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞进一袋沙
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a sack of sand

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了一下，站定
lines.en: The hit rocks me once and I settle

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，雪地不宽
lines.en: Do not walk against me, the snow is not wide

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我记住了方向
lines.en: I noted the direction when you pulled away

lines.zh: 我的手垂着，没有动
lines.en: My hands hang still

lines.zh: 那一下，连晃都没晃我
lines.en: That did not even rock me

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞在我胳膊上，麻的是你
lines.en: Your shoulder met my arm, yours is the numb one

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，看着你
lines.en: I tip my head and look at you

lines.zh: 脚下雪被踩碎，声音很脆
lines.en: The snow crust cracks loudly underfoot

lines.zh: 再撞，我就当你是挑衅
lines.en: Do that again and I take it as a challenge

lines.zh: 我是造出来的，没有这一项
lines.en: I was built, and this is not part of the design

lines.zh: 配对这种事，不在我的程序里
lines.en: Pairing up is not in my design

lines.zh: 你靠过来做什么
lines.en: What are you coming closer for

lines.zh: 我不懂这种话该怎么接
lines.en: I do not know how to answer that

lines.zh: 这具身子没有那个意思
lines.en: This body has no such meaning

lines.zh: 雪原上人少，但也不该是你
lines.en: Few people on the snowfield, but not you

lines.zh: 你伸手，我退了一步
lines.en: You reach out, and I step back

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要任务
lines.en: I need no company, only a task

lines.zh: 我的胸口冷得很，别碰
lines.en: My chest is cold, do not touch it

lines.zh: 话说到这儿就够了
lines.en: That is enough of that

lines.zh: 雪里的东西，我捡起来看看
lines.en: Something in the snow, I pick it up

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，动作很直
lines.en: I crouch, and the motion is stiff

lines.zh: 手一抖，雪就盖回去了
lines.en: My hand shakes and the snow covers it again

lines.zh: 这玩意儿没有用
lines.en: This thing is useless

lines.zh: 掉在雪里，捡不捡都一样
lines.en: Dropped in the snow, taking it or not is the same

lines.zh: 我擦掉上面的雪
lines.en: I brush the snow off it

lines.zh: 指甲刮了一下，声音难听
lines.en: My nail scrapes it, an ugly sound

lines.zh: 我拿在手里，掂了掂
lines.en: I hold it and weigh it in my palm

lines.zh: 这不是我需要的东西
lines.en: This is not what I need

lines.zh: 顺手带上，反正不占地方
lines.en: I take it along, it takes no room

lines.zh: 我看见你了，不用再找了
lines.en: I see you, no need to search further

lines.zh: 我脚下用力，雪往后溅
lines.en: I dig in and the snow sprays back

lines.zh: 你就是我这个任务
lines.en: You are the task itself

lines.zh: 我目不转睛，直线过来
lines.en: I do not look away and come straight at you

lines.zh: 雪地上没有遮蔽，你跑不掉
lines.en: There is no cover on the snowfield, you cannot hide

lines.zh: 我的速度不快，但很稳
lines.en: I am not fast, but I am constant

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就动身
lines.en: The moment you glance back, I move

lines.zh: 我已经确认了你的位置
lines.en: I have confirmed where you are

lines.zh: 这股气，总算明显了
lines.en: There, that ki is obvious enough

lines.zh: 别躲进松林，我会把树撞开
lines.en: Do not hide in the pines, I will smash through

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指向你
lines.en: I raise a hand and point at you

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，很好找
lines.en: You give off heat, that makes it easy

lines.zh: 我朝你走，越走越快
lines.en: I walk at you, quicker with every step

lines.zh: 雪从我的鞋边翻起来
lines.en: Snow peels up around my boots

lines.zh: 你做了个动作，我已经算到了
lines.en: You made a move, and I had it counted

lines.zh: 剩下的路，我自己走过来
lines.en: I will cover the rest of the way myself

lines.zh: 我沿着你的路走，不偏不倚
lines.en: I follow your path without drifting

lines.zh: 你跑得快，可停不下来
lines.en: You run fast, but you cannot stop running

lines.zh: 我一停，就锁定得更准
lines.en: When I stop, I lock on tighter

lines.zh: 我的鞋踩过的雪，你家也认得
lines.en: The snow my boots press, you could read your way home

lines.zh: 我在缩小距离，一寸一寸
lines.en: I am closing the gap, inch by inch

lines.zh: 你绕树，我也绕，只是慢些
lines.en: You circle the tree, I circle too, only slower

lines.zh: 不用喊，我不回话
lines.en: No need to shout, I will not answer

lines.zh: 这身子的气很稳，不会散
lines.en: The ki in this body is steady, it will not scatter

lines.zh: 你开始喘了，那就是近了
lines.en: You are panting now, that means closer

lines.zh: 我不追，我只堵
lines.en: I do not chase, I block

lines.zh: 雪坡滑，你往上跑会更慢
lines.en: The slope is slick, climbing makes you slower

lines.zh: 你在雪里留下的脚印很好认
lines.en: The prints you leave in the snow are clear

lines.zh: 我的手已经抬起来了
lines.en: My hand is already raised

lines.zh: 我不管你想做什么，只看你在哪
lines.en: I do not care what you intend, only where you are

lines.zh: 再往前是冰，你会摔
lines.en: Ahead is ice, you will fall

lines.zh: 我不出声，是让你以为我慢了
lines.en: I keep quiet so you think I have slowed

lines.zh: 你的气味在这一片最浓
lines.en: Your scent is thickest around here

lines.zh: 雪一停，视线就清楚了
lines.en: When the snow stops, the view clears

lines.zh: 我出拳很直，不花哨
lines.en: My punch goes straight, nothing fancy

lines.zh: 打在你肩上，声音很闷
lines.en: It lands on your shoulder with a dull sound

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往下一带
lines.en: I seize your wrist and pull it down

lines.zh: 这一脚扫在膝弯
lines.en: This kick sweeps the back of your knee

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的拳头就贴上来。
lines.en: Step back half an inch and my fist follows.

lines.zh: 一点点痛，对你对我都一样
lines.en: A little pain, same for you and me

lines.zh: 我砸下去，雪都溅起来
lines.en: I slam down and snow sprays up

lines.zh: 我手背一翻，撞在你下巴
lines.en: I turn my knuckles into your chin

lines.zh: 你护住了脸，肋下空着
lines.en: You guard your face and leave your ribs open

lines.zh: 这一下是我算好的
lines.en: That blow was calculated

lines.zh: 我扣住你的肩，往里按
lines.en: I clamp your shoulder and press inward

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，现在在我这里
lines.en: What was in your hand is in mine now

lines.zh: 我出手的时候没有表情
lines.en: My face does not change when I strike

lines.zh: 你退了四步，我进了一步
lines.en: You stepped back four times, I advanced once

lines.zh: 雪地被我们踩出两个坑
lines.en: We have worn two pits in the snow

lines.zh: 这一拳是直的，躲开才算
lines.en: This punch is straight, dodging is the only answer

lines.zh: 雪原上多了一个脚印
lines.en: A new trail has started on the snowfield

lines.zh: 我站在雪坡上，雪到脚踝
lines.en: I stand on the slope with snow to my ankles

lines.zh: 风里裹着一个人影
lines.en: The wind carries a figure with it

lines.zh: 我从树林边缘走出来
lines.en: I step out from the trees' edge

lines.zh: 雪地没有声音，除了我的脚
lines.en: The snowfield is silent except for my feet

lines.zh: 我停住，回头看了一眼
lines.en: I stop and look back once

lines.zh: 这一片很空旷，正合适
lines.en: This stretch is wide open, just right

lines.zh: 我没有带行李，也不需要
lines.en: I carry no baggage, and need none

lines.zh: 身上的雪很快积了一层
lines.en: Snow piles up on me quickly

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，天还没亮
lines.en: When I appear, it is still dark

lines.zh: 两三个一起落地，都是同样的脸
lines.en: Two or three land together, all with the same face

lines.zh: 远处的松林里惊起几只鸟
lines.en: A few birds start from the pines far off

lines.zh: 是制造出来的，所以落地很轻
lines.en: Made, and so I land lightly

lines.zh: 风吹起我脚边的雪
lines.en: The wind lifts the snow at my feet

lines.zh: 雪原上从此多了一个人
lines.en: The snowfield has a new figure from now on

lines.zh: 我抬头，白气很淡
lines.en: I look up, my breath is faint

lines.zh: 我整了整衣服，其实不用整
lines.en: I straighten my clothes, though there is no need

lines.zh: 这里很冷，我无所谓
lines.en: It is cold here, and it does not matter to me

lines.zh: 火烧过的地方发黑，皮在缩
lines.en: The fire left it black, the skin shrinking

lines.zh: 摔在冰面上，骨头响了一声
lines.en: I hit the ice and a bone sounded

lines.zh: 水比雪更难受，我喘不上气
lines.en: Water is worse than snow, I cannot breathe

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡了很久
lines.en: The blast left my ears ringing for a long while

lines.zh: 一支箭插在肩膀，我没拔
lines.en: An arrow is in my shoulder, I leave it

lines.zh: 那股劲儿在我身体里乱撞
lines.en: That force is knocking around inside me

lines.zh: 雪原上没有食物，我也不需要
lines.en: No food on the snowfield, and I need none

lines.zh: 雷打在雪坡上，我的腿僵了
lines.en: Lightning hit the slope and my legs stiffened

lines.zh: 这里没有雪，脚下空空
lines.en: No snow here, and nothing underfoot
